claim_text: The United Arab Emirates said Iran attacked an ADNOC vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, the third UAE tanker struck within a week, and urged the reopening of the waterway, according to reports published on 15 August 2026.
quote: UAE says Iran attacked ADNOC vessel in Hormuz, urges waterway's reopening
confidence_justification: Attribution of the attack rests on the UAE government's own account, though the strike itself is reported by Reuters, Fox News and The Hill.
